model_type: Gradient boosting, 825 trees, max. 31 leaves, monotone (non-decreasing) in the planned 3rd-attempt weight
target: probability that the 3rd deadlift attempt fails (dl3_failed = 1)

features.name: has_prev_best
features.formula: 1 if a previous competition best is given

features.name: pb_gap
features.formula: clip(ln(DL2 / previous best), -0.4, 0.4), 0 without previous best

features.name: age_Sub-Junior
features.formula: 1 if age group is Sub-Junior (baseline Open)

features.name: age_Junior
features.formula: 1 if age group is Junior (baseline Open)

features.name: age_Masters
features.formula: 1 if age group is Masters (baseline Open)

features.name: age_Unknown
features.formula: 1 if age group is Unknown (baseline Open)

features.name: pr_excess
features.formula: max(0, ln(planned / previous best)) - max(0, ln(DL2 / previous best))

threshold_rule: highest precision with recall >= 0.7 on the validation split

selection.rule: D-19: validation PR-AUC >= v1 + 0.005, monotone, calibrated within 2 points, coach-providable inputs

candidates_validation.candidate: GBM + new features, 31 leaves, min leaf 200, 825 trees
GBM + new features, 63 leaves, min leaf 200, 425 trees
GBM + new features, 63 leaves, min leaf 1000, 300 trees
GBM + new features, 127 leaves, min leaf 500, 225 trees
GBM v1 features, 63 leaves, min leaf 200, 200 trees

limitations: Learned from competition results: coaches already pick smaller jumps after a slow 2nd attempt, so the data cannot show how much safer a small jump is for a given athlete. The risk is constrained never to fall when the weight rises.
Day form, warm-ups, bar speed and weight cutting are not in the data. Treat the output as one input to the coach's decision.
Federations judge differently, and only the last declared 3rd-attempt weight is recorded.
Small groups (Mx, Multi-ply, Unlimited, very young or old lifters) have few cases; predictions there are less reliable.
A tree ensemble is harder to explain than v1's logistic regression; v1 stays in the repository as the tested baseline.
